newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Konsortium says near deal for MISC stake.
newsitem.headline: Konsortium says near deal for MISC stake.

text.p: Shipping firm Konsortium Perkapalan Bhd said it was close to finalising a deal to acquire a 29.35 percent stake in national carrier, Malaysian International Shipping Corp Bhd.

Its executive vice chairman Loo Hooi Keat was quoted as saying by the Star newspaper that negotiations, which had been stuck over price of the shares, for the stake purchase were expected to be completed by the end of September.
"We are still negotiating with the major shareholders of MISC," he said.
"The deal is worth more than two billion ringgit and the structure has got to be right," Loo said.
He said the present shareholders had acquired the shares at 10.50 ringgit each and now the prices were down to six ringgit a share.
